run_linear_separability_training: run the CPC linear separability trainer to evaluate speaker or phone separability on audio data
run_train_step: run a single training step for the linear separability criterion with backpropagation and optimizer updates
run_val_step: run a single validation step to compute loss and accuracy for the linear separability criterion
run_parse_args: parse command line arguments for the linear separability trainer including paths, GPU count, and hyperparameters
run_main: run the main entry point that loads models, sets up data loaders, and starts linear separability training
